messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — prepping EBR for Harborline. Need slide owners, renewal risk snapshot, and enablement asks. Deck: https://redwood.example/ebrs/harborline. Can owners confirm slides by EOD Wed? TL;DR: onboarding delays, 1 high renewal risk, 2 medium risks.

Owen Patel: On it. I'll take 'Onboarding velocity' (slide 4) and add updated activation metrics. ETA tomorrow noon. I'll include a brief customer quote.

Priya Singh: I'll own 'Renewal risk & mitigations' (slide 7). Need telemetry for dropped pipelines — @Sam can you paste the key metrics here?

Sam Alvarez: Sending the snapshot now. Pasting quick numbers:

```
activation_week1: 62%
activation_week2: 70%
churn_signal: 8% (up 2ppt)
failed_ingest_rate: 3.4% (last 7d)
```

Sam Alvarez: Also opened SR I-8823 with infra for pipeline retries — adding SR to action items.

Lena Wu: I'll take 'Enablement & playbook' slide and capture the enablement session plan + owners. FYI I scheduled the enablement workshop Fri 11am — invites out.

Maya Chen: Great. Priya, include 'escalation POC' and proposed offer (3-month Optimize consult). Assign 'exec talking points' to me (I'll draft bullets).

Priya Singh: Ack. Adding bullets. Quick Q — do we have legal approval for the promo? @Lena, can you confirm?

Lena Wu: Legal confirmed yesterday via slack thread with LegalBot — promo ok :white_check_mark:.

EBR Bot: Reminder — upload final deck to /share/ebrs/harborline by Thu 17:00 or automated checklist will mark deck stale.

Maya Chen: Two quick asks before upload: 1) Priya, mark the risk as 'High — renewal at risk' if projected NRR < 0.95; 2) Owen, add appendix slide with latency improvement timeline and estimated uplift.

Owen Patel: Will add latency appendix. Also proposing a 4-week remediation plan for onboarding backlog (slide 6) — short bullets + owners.

Sam Alvarez: Noted — I'll add the SR and a short incident summary to slide 8.

Maya Chen: Let's do a dry run Thu 09:00 — calendar invite sent. Please have slides in deck by Wed EOD so we can iterate. If any blockers, ping me here. :raised_hands:

Priya Singh: :thumbsup: Confirming I'll push updates tonight and tag owners on specific bullets.
